bookingOpens: Online on SevenRooms, by phone or by email (oiseaublancppr@peninsula.com).
cancellation: A card guarantee is needed for every booking. Cancelling up to 48 hours ahead is free (by email); later cancellations cost €200 per person at lunch and €300 per person at dinner. Special evenings such as Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve and Valentine's Day have their own terms.
groups: Tables of five to seven pay a deposit of €100 per person at lunch or €200 per person at dinner, taken off the final bill. The Balcony Table (a private terrace for two) and the Secret Table (a private rooftop setting) can be requested, weather permitting, until the end of October.
